## Usage Instructions:

\

    **1. Create a New Note:** Begin by creating a new note.

\

    **2. Activate Kanban View:** Click the three dots in the top right corner, then select \*\*"Kanban Plugin: Create Board"\*\* to transform the note into a kanban board.
